items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: When you mix other fellas like Billy Bauer, who is a genius in his own right in any phase of musical arrangement, along with the very healthy marriage that somehow or another came about with the Neal Hefti-Basie marriage there.

ctx.x: a young genius. He could arrange anything of any mood, if you would just tie him down long enough. Frank West was an excellent arranger, although he did very little in the band. He was an excellent arranger. Then Thad Jones came into the band and he was a monster. He was latter-day Duke Ellington type arranger. That is the way that I feel.

When you mix other fellas like Billy Bauer, who is a genius in his own right in any phase of musical arrangement, along with the very healthy marriage that somehow or another came about with the Neal Hefti-Basie marriage there. They were good for each other. Neal Hefti couldn't sell none of his tunes with his own band, so he wrote them and gave them to Basie and we changed the tempos of all of them and played it our way and made him -- made his _______ rating go very high, which I'm sure he's thankful of, maybe.
